near_misses.item: historical-data-manager Access table-name f-string into pd.read_sql
near_misses.why: pd.read_sql(f'SELECT * FROM [{table}]', conn) executes, and table names come from the Access catalog of a provided .mdb/.accdb. Microsoft Access forbids [] in table names, blocking ]-breakout identifier injection via normal DB creation. Stub never appends rows to records. Requires operator to open the vendor file locally — no networked auto-ingest webhook. Connection-string DBQ={file_path} similarly needs operator-chosen path.
